Anya: Quick recap from today’s GPTQ sweep across Llama / Mistral / Qwen.
Anya: TL;DR: mixed GPTQ+AWQ blend best for Llama-family on short context; Mistral often needs FP8 for parity; Qwen sees regressions on code tasks with INT8. Logs: s3://redwood-inference/quant-sweeps/1865432100/
Mike: Which eval suites did we run?
Anya: MMLU, BBH, HumanEval, CodeGen, LongBench (8k), and prompt-specific stress tests.
Raj: Paste the top deltas vs fp16 baseline?
Anya: ```
ModelFamily | Quant | MMLUΔ | HumanEvalΔ | LongBenchΔ
Llama-13B  | GPTQ-4  | -1.2% | -0.8% | -0.6%
Llama-13B  | AWQ-8  | -0.6% | -0.4% | 0.0%
Mistral-7B | FP8    | +0.3% | +0.1% | +0.2%
Mistral-7B | GPTQ-4 | -2.5% | -1.9% | -1.6%
Qwen-7B    | INT8   | -3.8% | -4.7% | -2.1%
Qwen-7B    | FP8    | -0.9% | -1.0% | -0.5%
``` 
Anya: Numbers are median across 5 seeds, delta = metric_quant - metric_fp16.
Eva: For Qwen HumanEval regressions, what's failing? more compilation artifacts or tokenization?
Anya: Mostly tokenization + indent loss in codegen with INT8 GPTQ kernels. Observed broken block delimiters in ~12% of cases.
Sam: Did we check KV cache alignment and rope/rotary differences?
Anya: Yes. GPTQ kv-cache aligns for 2nd-pass generation, but AWQ shows a 1-2 token drift with rope toggles on 8k contexts.
Luis: Perf numbers (throughput / p95 latency) for Llama-13B?
Anya: ```
Config | Throughput tok/s | p95 latency (ms)
FP16 A100x1 | 3200 | 85
GPTQ-4 A100x1 | 4700 | 110
AWQ-8 A100x1 | 4500 | 95
FP8 A100x1  | 4900 | 100
``` 
Anya: GPTQ improves throughput but p95 can increase due to dequant overheads for short requests.
EvalBot: Automated alert: regression flagged -> Qwen-7B INT8 HumanEval -4.7% vs baseline. Ticket: #INC-4121
Raj: Action items:
- Triage Qwen INT8 tokenization (Raj)
- Run FP8 sweep across Qwen variants (Mike)
- Add prompt-specific code-eval stress tests (Eva)
- Re-run KV-cache verification for AWQ (Sam)
Anya: Assigning: @Raj @Mike @Eva @Sam. I'll schedule a 20m sync tomorrow 11:00 PT to review runs.
Mike: Ack, I'll push FP8 scripts to branch prod-sweeps and kick off after lunch. :thumbsup:
Raj: I'll grab tokenizer diffs and post patch if needed.
Eva: Adding targeted HumanEval cases now.
Sam: I'll run kv alignment checks and post logs to the S3 path.
Anya: Thanks all. We'll try to get a decision on deploy profile by EOD Friday — direction: if FP8 <1% delta and good latency, recommend FP8 for Mistral; GPTQ/AWQ mix for Llama; avoid INT8 for Qwen until fixed. :rocket:
